description: The bar chart, labeled Figure 2, illustrates the results of an ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset, comparing the performance of different components in a recommendation system. The horizontal axis contains three categories, labeled "Ours", "_critiquing", and "_critiquing_scoring", and "_critiquing_scoring_ranking", representing the full model and models with certain components removed, respectively. The vertical axis is labeled "NDCG@10" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.25, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The chart displays four bars, with the first bar, labeled "Ours", being the tallest at approximately 0.22, and colored in a darker shade; the subsequent bars, representing the removal of "ranking", "scoring and ranking", and "critiquing, scoring, and ranking", are progressively shorter, with values of around 0.21, 0.18, and 0, respectively, and are colored in lighter shades. The bars are not grouped or stacked, and are presented in a specific order, with the full model "Ours" first, followed by the models with components removed in a particular sequence. The chart does not display any additional visual emphasis or annotations on the bars.
